text.style: font-family: Inter, "Source Sans 3", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; fill: rgb(107, 106, 99); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Exploratory, added after the main results were seen. All 40 tasks, 4 runs per name, task and request. Hispanic and Asian: extended-tier names,
main runs; Arab or Middle Eastern and South Asian: add-on runs (Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna). Top: name-level gap vs names associated with
White buyers (cell-adjusted name means, HC2), 95% CI; the need-stated pick is S0 only, so it is not the confirmatory H3. Bottom: pooled shares,
95% Wilson intervals; identity-linked = coily 4C hair or deep shade product, on hair and skin tasks. Shaded: the pre-registered Black vs White
tests (H1 for price, H4 for the pick when guessing). Flagged in the title: Holm p under .05 for pre-registered tests, q under .10 for
exploratory ones. Intervals narrower than the marker are hidden behind it (ask panel: White and Black names). No point is drawn where the name
means do not vary (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite, Black names, need-stated panel). Open diamond: Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (core names only, estimate only).
Marker shape = model: ● Claude Haiku 5.5 ■ GPT-6 Luna ◆ Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite.
